name: Wavering
overview: Scripture calls believers to steadfast faith and endurance, encouraging them to wait on the Lord with courage and strength (Psalms 27:14). Christians are exhorted not to grow weary or faint in doing good, trusting that in due season they will reap if they do not give up (Galatians 6:9). The call to stand firm is reinforced by putting on the whole armor of God to withstand evil and to hold fast without wavering, confident in God's faithfulness to His promises (Ephesians 6:13; Hebrews 10:23). Additionally, believers are urged to draw near with full assurance of faith and to continue gathering together for mutual encouragement as the day of Christ’s return approaches (Hebrews 10:22, 25).
